# NORD-100 bus at a card position (plug C)

Machine NORD-100 (ND-100) · catalogue file [catalog/signals/nd-bus-nd100.json](https://github.com/RetroCoreLabs/RetroSchematic/blob/master/src/catalog/signals/nd-bus-nd100.json) · format and background in [Bus signals and connectors](../../BUS-SIGNALS.md)

## How to read the table

- **active**: low = true when the line is low (ND suffix 0); high = true when high (suffix 1); none = power
- **direction**: seen from an I/O card: in, out, bidir, 'out, open collector (shared)'
- **confidence**: read = stated in the source; inferred = worked out, the note says from what; open = not known
- **pins**: connector C, row a/b/c, pin 1-32 (96 pins), from the backplane table
- **letters**: not used

| [GND](#gnd) | C a1, C a11, C a24, C a32, C b1, C b11, C b24, C b32, C c1, C c11, C c24, C c32 | none | in | Logic ground return. |
| [+5V](#5v) | C a2, C a31, C b2, C b31, C c2, C c31 | none | in | Main logic supply. |
| [+15V](#15v) | C a25, C b25, C c25 | none | in | Supply for analogue interface circuits, for customer use. |
| [An. Return](#an-return) | C a26, C b26, C c26 | none | in | Separate ground for analogue circuits, joined to logic ground at the power supply (+/-15 V supply). |
| [-15V](#-15v) | C a27, C b27, C c27 | none | in | Supply for analogue interface circuits, for customer use. |
| [+12V](#12v) | C a28, C b28, C c28 | none | in | The table prints +12V; the voltage list on the following page has '+12V Standby: supply for memory, needs battery backup'. That the two are the same line is inferred. |
| [POW. SENSE](#pow-sense) | C a29, C b29, C c29 | none | in | open |
| [5V St.by](#5v-stby) | C a30, C b30, C c30 | none | in | Logic supply for memory kept alive during power failure. |

### control

| Signal | Pins | Active | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| [BREF](#bref) | C a12 | low | not used by I/O cards | open |
| [BINPUT](#binput) | C a18 | low | out, wired OR (shared) | Bus Input, signalled by a unit that will send data. I/O interfaces must wait for BINACK before enabling data and BDRY. Wired OR line. |
| [BAPR](#bapr) | C a20 | low | bidir, wired OR (shared) | Bus Address Present on the shared data and address bus. Wired OR line. |
| [INCONTR](#incontr) | C a21 | low | unused (future extensions) | Answer to BCRQ saying control over the bus is available. A unit that does not want control passes it on as OUTCONTR to the next position further from the controlling unit. |
| [INGRANT](#ingrant) | C a23 | low | in | Answer to BREQ: the bus is free for a DMA cycle. An interface that sent BREQ before the last leading edge of BMEM may use the bus for one memory read or write; otherwise it passes INGRANT on as OUTGRANT to the next lower-priority position (further from the controlling unit). |
| [LOAD](#load) | C b12 | low | out, wired OR (shared) | Starts the load microprogram if the CPU is in STOP mode. Wired OR line (only in the CPU crate). |
| [RESTART](#restart) | C b13 | low | out, wired OR (shared) | Starts program execution at location 20 (octal) if the CPU is in STOP mode. Wired OR line (only in the CPU crate). |
| [RUN](#run) | C b14 | low | in | The CPU is running a program, i.e. not in STOP mode. Generated by the CPU (only in the CPU crate). |
| [CONTINUE](#continue) | C b15 | low | out, wired OR (shared) | May be used to start a CPU that is in STOP mode. Wired OR line (only in the CPU crate). |
| [STOP](#stop) | C b16 | low | out, wired OR (shared) | Forces the CPU into STOP mode after the current instruction. Wired OR line (only in the CPU crate). |
| [BLANK](#blank) | C b17 | low | bidir, wired OR (shared) | Output blanking signal for process interfaces. Wired OR, generated by a monitoring device. |
| [BPERR](#bperr) | C b18 | low | not used by I/O cards | Bus Parity Error: fatal or correctable error from memory, according to the ECC register. |
| [BINACK](#binack) | C b19 | low | in | Bus Input Acknowledge: an interface that asked for an input operation may now put its data on the bus. Generated by the controlling unit. |
| [BMCL](#bmcl) | C b20 | low | bidir, wired OR (shared) | Bus Master Clear: resets the logic at power-up and when the Master Clear button is pushed. Wired OR line. |
| [BERROR](#berror) | C b21 | low | unused (future extensions) | Bus Error: an error was found during a bus cycle, e.g. a fatal memory error. Wired OR line. |
| [BCRQ](#bcrq) | C b22 | low | unused (future extensions) | Bus Control Request from a unit that wants full control over the bus (for future extensions). Wired OR line. |
| [BMINH](#bminh) | C b23 | low | not used by I/O cards | Bus Memory Inhibit: blocks memory accesses during power-down and power-up in systems with battery backup for memory only. Generated by the controlling unit. |
| [BREQ](#breq) | C c12 | low | out, wired OR (shared) | Request for a DMA cycle. Wired OR line. |
| [BIOXE](#bioxe) | C c19 | low | in | Input/Output Enable: a strobe to enable data transfer to or from an I/O interface. Generated by the controlling unit. |
| [BMEM](#bmem) | C c20 | low | in | Bus Memory Cycle: the bus cycle accesses memory. Generated by the controlling unit. |
| [OUTCONTR](#outcontr) | C c21 | low | unused (future extensions) | See INCONTR: passed on to INCONTR of the next position. |
| [OUTGRANT](#outgrant) | C c23 | low | out | See INGRANT: passed on to INGRANT of the next lower-priority position. |

### ident

| Signal | Pins | Active | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| [INIDENT](#inident) | C a22 | low | in | Answer to BINT10-13, together with address bits 0-5 that give the BINT number. An interface that raised BINT on that level before the last leading edge of BAPR puts its IDENT code on the BD lines; otherwise it passes INIDENT on as OUTIDENT to the next lower-priority position. |
| [OUTIDENT](#outident) | C c22 | low | out | See INIDENT: passed on to INIDENT of the next lower-priority position. |

## Sources

| Code | Document | Note |
|---|---|---|
| NDI | NDInsight repository, SINTRAN/Devices/BusSignals/ND-100-BUS-C-CONNECTOR.md (commit f62ddaa2) | Secondary source. Its pin table comes from the owner's spreadsheet 'ND-120 Commands' (sheets C-BUS, C-PLUG); its driver and pull-up facts describe the ND-120 3202D CPU card. The ND original of those facts was not checked here. Where its source/used codes disagree with the 1980 table image, the image wins (see 'disagreements'). |
| N100 | ND-06.016.01 NORD-100 Input/Output System (1980) | Appendix F gives the full backplane table (connector C, rows a/b/c, pins 1-32) and a definition of each signal; section I.2.3 names the plugs A, B, C. |
| V120 | nd-120 repository, Verilog/CPU-BOARD-3202/circuit/ND3202D.v (module ND3202D, the ND-120 3202D CPU board in Verilog, port list 'BACKPLANE C-PLUG') | A re-creation of the CPU card, not an ND document. Port names and the C-plug positions in its comments are recorded; the ND manual stays the authority. |
| KC | KiCad project NDModulE-v3-reduced (kept outside this repository), sheet SystemBusC.kicad_sch, connector J1 'BUS-C' (DIN 41612 3x32, footprint DIN41612_R_3x32_Male_Horizontal_THT) | A modern ND-bus card design, not an ND document. Net names were taken from a netlist exported with kicad-cli 9.0 from the root sheet NDModuleE-v3-reduced.kicad_sch. |
| XL | Owner's spreadsheet 'ND-120 Commands' (kept outside this repository): sheets A-PLUG, B-PLUG, C-PLUG (ND-BUS), C-BUS, Signal Names | Second-hand: the owner's notes, partly typed from ND-06.016.01 Appendix F and partly from the ND-120 3202D CPU schematics ('ND-120 schematics' is written under the A-PLUG sheet). The NDInsight C-connector note appears to be made from this spreadsheet (it names the same sheets as its source). Confidence of its facts is 'inferred'; ND manual facts are never replaced. |
